About this item

  • More than a Desk Light: This office lamp isn't just for brightening your workspace—it's designed to brighten you, too. With a slight adjustment in direction or position, this LED desk light seamlessly transitions from a desk lamp to a webcam light. You could say it combines the functionality of a desk lamp and a ring light;
  • Professional Eye-Caring Lighting: Enjoy soft, evenly distributed light that helps reduce eye strain during long hours of work, study, or screen time. Powered by diffused, edge-lit LED technology, this table lamp delivers smooth, balanced illumination. Easily adjust brightness and color temperature to match any environment, with memory & timer for added convenience—perfect for reading, drawing, writing, studying and more;
  • Enhance Your Appearance: If you're looking to enhance your webcam video presence and have an incredibly versatile desk light for any situation you can imagine, this video conference light (CRI≥95, very close to natural light) is a game changer. You’ll look clearer, more vibrant, and more professional in Zoom meetings, video calls, and live streams;
  • Adjustable Swing Arm: The desktop lamp features five pivot joints in its swing arm, allowing you to effortlessly adjust the angles and height to suit your workspace. The Zoom light comes with a 26.7'' rotating arm, a 7.09'' rotating head, and a 0.27'' thickness metal lamp base;
  • Stable & Movable: The strong metal table lamp base with adjustable joints maintains its position without toppling over time. Before purchasing a desk lamp with clamp, it's important to consider the thickness of your desk or whether your workspace is against a wall. With our task light, you won't have these concerns. Since it is not fixed, you can easily move it to wherever you need. It's suitable for all types of workspaces;
  • 24/7 Customer Service: Our desk lamp features 84 LED beads designed to last 100,000 hours, ensuring infrequent replacements. We offer a 36-month warranty service for peace of mind. Should you experience any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're committed to promptly resolving any problems you may encounter;
  • Love in Every Glow: Warm Light, Lasting Companionship. A thoughtful gift for Valentine’s Day or Christmas—this unique desk lamp brings comfort to everyday moments and reminds your spouse how much they mean to you.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Excellent by for the money.
    I purchased a Litones desk lamp from Amazon and have found it to be well built and sturdy. It has various brightness and mood/mode settings. When it first arrived I had problems with it, which turned out to be of my own making because I was not following instructions and therein is the reason for this review. I contacted the supplier and they bent over backwards to assist me including shipping a replacement lamp. With instructions from the representative of the supplier I learned to use the lamps and found they are very easy to manipulate if you just follow the instructions. All you have to do is lightly touch the icons indicating the power switch, the plus icon to brighten the light, minus icon to dim, etc. I now use two of them on each side of the work area on my desk and am very pleased with them.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Visually appealing, nice size, sensible controls that remember your previous settings!
      Reviewed in the United States on February 10, 2025
      Color: Black (1-Pack)
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      First of all, I really appreciate a desk lamp that can simulate the warm glow of an incandescent lamp (this is 3k, not 2.7k which is close enough for me). The harsh white/blue colors of many LED lamps don't do it for me but if that is what you want, you can get that here too! In addition, I think it is nice to have a consistent light color throughout the entire house and the warm color is consistent with the rest of my home.

      I also really appreciate that I can turn it on/off and have it come back on at the LAST SETTINGS that I had previously!! I don't have to re-set my preference every time I turn on the lamp which is not uncommon (I have other lamps that I have to press the button 3-4+ times to get it to the intensity and/or color that I want every time I turn it on). Once you set your preference, it remembers it!

      It is somewhat of a minimalist design, just enough equipment to do what it needs to do. The black color matches the other things on my desktop. It does have quite a lot of brightness levels which I also appreciate.

      I find the height to be about right. If it is too tall, it can get in the way, and if it is too short, it may not be flexible enough for enough circumstances. I have my lamp behind the computer monitor, but then position the light over and towards the desktop in front of my screen. I can then reach underneath or around the monitor quite easily to turn the light on/off.

      Overall good value and nice, thoughtful, functionality.

      Bought this light almost two years ago. Provided easy to use and versatile service, until the day I moved it. Then it stopped working. Couldn't get it to function at all.       My only comment for improvement would be the website. If you register the light, the warranty is extended from two to three years. Unfortunately, even after trying multiple ways, I was never able to complete the registration. Hopefully I won't need any more support.

      Thanks LitONES!

    About this Item

    • More than a Desk Light: This office lamp isn't just for brightening your workspace—it's designed to brighten you, too. With a slight adjustment in direction or position, this LED desk light seamlessly transitions from a desk lamp to a webcam light. You could say it combines the functionality of a desk lamp and a ring light;
    • Professional Eye-Caring Lighting: Enjoy soft, evenly distributed light that helps reduce eye strain during long hours of work, study, or screen time. Powered by diffused, edge-lit LED technology, this table lamp delivers smooth, balanced illumination. Easily adjust brightness and color temperature to match any environment, with memory & timer for added convenience—perfect for reading, drawing, writing, studying and more;
    • Enhance Your Appearance: If you're looking to enhance your webcam video presence and have an incredibly versatile desk light for any situation you can imagine, this video conference light (CRI≥95, very close to natural light) is a game changer. You’ll look clearer, more vibrant, and more professional in Zoom meetings, video calls, and live streams;
    • Adjustable Swing Arm: The desktop lamp features five pivot joints in its swing arm, allowing you to effortlessly adjust the angles and height to suit your workspace. The Zoom light comes with a 26.7'' rotating arm, a 7.09'' rotating head, and a 0.27'' thickness metal lamp base;
    • Stable & Movable: The strong metal table lamp base with adjustable joints maintains its position without toppling over time. Before purchasing a desk lamp with clamp, it's important to consider the thickness of your desk or whether your workspace is against a wall. With our task light, you won't have these concerns. Since it is not fixed, you can easily move it to wherever you need. It's suitable for all types of workspaces;
    • 24/7 Customer Service: Our desk lamp features 84 LED beads designed to last 100,000 hours, ensuring infrequent replacements. We offer a 36-month warranty service for peace of mind. Should you experience any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're committed to promptly resolving any problems you may encounter;
    • Love in Every Glow: Warm Light, Lasting Companionship. A thoughtful gift for Valentine’s Day or Christmas—this unique desk lamp brings comfort to everyday moments and reminds your spouse how much they mean to you.
